detailed_descriptions.en: You are the last Dwarven King. The final spark of hope for a fading civilization. With a handful of survivors and blueprints etched by ancestors long gone, you must descend into the mountain once more and reclaim your ancestral halls from the deranged mechanical Constructs, layer by layer… The Craaghelm DLC features a wealth of additional content for Thronefall , including new maps, weapons, perks, mutators, heroes, and units. Explore and conquer 8 thematic maps: Widerhall, Myrkforst, Brewerk, Lichtspalt, Grundsteg, Schattengrund, Tiefenlift, and Zentrum. Each map's terrain can work for you or against you. Moving platforms, lava streams, and blocked choke points demand that you adapt or perish. Mithril and Energy Cores mined and created from these lands long ago are the new measures of currency to fuel your reclamation. Wield devastating weapons forged by Dwarven lords. Dominate close combat with the Dragon’s Roar, or stand steadfast with the Twin Bastions; dual shields ready for the oncoming onslaught. Fortify your path to victory with new perks. From spiked walls protecting your economic buildings to healing hot springs, granting much-needed health in intense battles. Additional challenging mutators. Expect disorientating volcanic ash, natural disasters, boulders, and more. Prepare or become buried in defeat. Rally new forces to your banner. Axe throwers strike foes on ground and in air alike; for those who'd rather answer chaos with cold steel and steam, Airships and Walker Tanks await your command. Not all who come for your throne are flesh and blood. The Clockwork Oliphaunt crushes all before it, while Loot Goblins and Leap Bots gnaw at your economy and your ranks. Call upon ancient heroes and command The Technician, Siege Engineer, and mighty Dwarven Spirit Warriors to fight alongside you in the battle against the Constructs.
